title: 303 independently tabbable SVG work nodes made the keyboard path O(node count)
workflow: keyboard consumption -> count focus stops -> Board accessibility critique -> source repair -> real browser re-consumption
symptom: Every one of the 303 visual work nodes was role=button and tabindex=0. Axe was clean, but ordinary Tab navigation had 303 map-node stops before leaving the visual field.
expected_behavior: Map navigation should remain O(1) in the page Tab sequence while every Work remains keyboard-reachable through a stable equivalent control path.
actual_behavior: Baseline real Chromium measurement found zeroTabNodes=303, minusOneNodes=0, roleButtons=303.
proposed_fix: Use one map-level Tab stop and a bounded ordinary-DOM search result control path for individual Work selection; keep pointer SVG hotspots out of the accessibility/Tab tree because conceptual spatial adjacency is composition, not stable semantic navigation.
fix_attempt: SVG now has one tabindex=0 group; the 303 pointer hotspots are aria-hidden visual marks with no role/button/tabindex. Search renders at most 12 native buttons and exact Work-ID queries provide direct selection.
verification: Real Chromium R3: nodeTab0=0, nodeButtons=0, mapTab0=1; exact-ID search reached 303/303 Works, keyboard Enter selected Signal Garden, console errors=0, mobile page overflow=0. Repeat Nu Html Checker PASS messageCount=0; Chromium 153 + axe 0 violations; Firefox 155 PASS.
